summary.migrationType: ASP.NET Web Forms to ASP.NET Core Razor Pages

layers: TourManagement.Domain - Domain entities and repository interfaces
TourManagement.Application - Application services, DTOs, and business logic
TourManagement.Infrastructure - EF Core implementations, DbContext, and data access
TourManagement.Web - ASP.NET Core Razor Pages presentation layer
testProjects: TourManagement.UnitTests - Unit tests with xUnit, Moq, FluentAssertions
TourManagement.IntegrationTests - Integration tests with InMemory database

keyChanges.webFramework: Migrated from ASP.NET Web Forms (.aspx) to ASP.NET Core Razor Pages (.cshtml)
keyChanges.dataAccess: Migrated from ADO.NET to Entity Framework Core 8.0 with SQL Server
keyChanges.dependencyInjection: Implemented native ASP.NET Core DI container
keyChanges.sessionManagement: Migrated from System.Web.SessionState to ASP.NET Core Session
keyChanges.patterns: Implemented Repository Pattern and Service Layer Pattern

entitiesMigrated: Tour - Tour package information and details
UserInfo - User account and profile information
Booking - Tour booking records linking users and tours
issuesResolved: CS0234: Circular dependency between Domain and Application layers - moved service interfaces to Application layer
CS1061: Missing AutoMapper extension method - added AutoMapper.Extensions.Microsoft.DependencyInjection package
CS0246: Namespace references not updated - updated all using statements after interface reorganization
CS0542: Member names same as enclosing type - renamed properties from LoginModel/RegisterModel/TourModel to Input
CS0246: Moq not available in IntegrationTests - replaced with NullLogger pattern

tables: Tours - Tour packages with pricing and details
Bookings - Tour reservations linking users and tours

nextSteps: Update connection string in appsettings.json with actual database server details
Run EF Core migrations: dotnet ef migrations add InitialCreate --project src/TourManagement.Infrastructure --startup-project src/TourManagement.Web
Apply migrations: dotnet ef database update --project src/TourManagement.Infrastructure --startup-project src/TourManagement.Web
Configure authentication middleware if needed (currently using session-based authentication)
Deploy to hosting environment (IIS, Azure App Service, Docker, etc.)
Run unit and integration tests: dotnet test
